digest.component_or_area: structured output recovery (pai_structured, pai_retry, Agent operation)
propositions: Manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured must be replaced with a single bounded Agent operation that preserves full history and request budget across retry attempts
Wire-context projection via HistoryProcessor must include failed ModelResponse on retry wire only when its token usage plus effective_max_tokens provably fits the model window, else omit it whole
Authoritative input overflow (input_tokens + effective_max_tokens exceeding window) must fail closed with ContextWindowExceededError without shortening content

Truncation signals (length or max_tokens finish_reason) on prompted-output branch must trigger concision retry within the shared output-retry allowance, while terminal errors (refusal/content_filter) bypass retry
Combined request budget (base ceil(eff_max_iter/2) plus output-retry allowance) must be set once per operation with no per-attempt reset
NativeOutput branch must preserve guard_capability behavior, grammar-compilation fallback, and terminal truncation while sharing the bounded operation and wire projection
